description: Set up tracking from the Animation menu on one layer: Track Motion (adds a point tracker and opens the layer in the Layer panel), Track Mask (the mask tracker for the chosen masks), Track this Property (a track that drives the chosen property), Paste Mocha mask (Edit menu), Track in Boris FX Mocha; or open the Tracker panel or the Motion Tracking workspace (Window menu). The analysis itself runs from the Tracker panel; read and edit the resulting track points with get_tracking_data and set_track_point

action.description: track_motion, track_mask, track_property, paste_mocha_mask, track_in_mocha, tracker_panel (Window > Tracker) or workspace (Motion Tracking workspace)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: The layer: one index (1-based, from list_layers), name, or selected: true

masks.description: track_mask: mask indexes (1-based); omit for every mask on the layer

property.description: track_property: the property the track drives. A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]

time.description: Move the current time here first (tracking starts from the current time)

name: start_tracking
title: Start Tracking
